svg.title: A sequence diagram drawn as rail tracks, one vertical track per role: you, coordinator, planner, implementer, and reviewer. You hand the coordinator an issue and answer its questions. The coordinator briefs the planner, gets the plan back, and brings you the decisions. It passes the answers to the implementer, gets a commit, sends it to the reviewer, and gets a verdict, repeating build and review until the verdict is pass. The coordinator opens a pull request, you approve it, and the coordinator merges.
